## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a red-first regression test for a fix)
- [ ] README / docs updated if behaviour or the public API changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] No new dependency in `go.mod` (or it is justified in CONTRIBUTING.md and approved)
